description: Cross-language contract fixture for the structured subagent status field. Task result text is display content only and is not part of this wire contract. The optional subagent_stop_reason field (v2, #3875 Phase 2) carries why a guardrail cap ended a run early; it is ignored by older consumers that only read subagent_status. v3 adds time_capped: a subagent that hit its timeout_seconds but had produced usable partial work now surfaces as completed + time_capped instead of discarding everything.
